module Cardano.Tx exposing (validAfter, signedBy)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)
import Eq exposing (Eq)
import Lift exposing (lower)

-- V3 TxInfo field 7 is the validity interval. Require a finite lower bound.
-- Times are POSIX milliseconds, not slots or the current wall-clock time.
validAfter : Data -> int
validAfter tx =
    case tx of
        Constr pair(0, [ _, _, _, _, _, _, _, Constr pair(0, [ Constr pair(0, [ Constr pair(1, [ I time ]), _ ]), _ ]), _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ ]) -> time
        _ -> fail

-- V3 TxInfo field 8 contains every extra signatory.
signedBy : Data -> Bytes -> bool
signedBy tx owner =
    case tx of
        Constr pair(0, [ _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, List signers, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ ]) -> hasSigner signers (lower owner)
        _ -> fail

hasSigner : list Data -> bytes -> bool
hasSigner signers owner =
    case signers of
        [] -> False
        B signer :: rest ->
            if Builtin.equalsByteString signer owner then True
            else hasSigner rest owner
        _ -> fail
sources.Eq:
module Eq exposing ( Eq )


import Literal
import Logic exposing ( not, xor, (&&) )
import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)


{-| Compare values for equality and inequality. -}
trait Eq 'a where
    eq : 'a -> 'a -> bool

    neq : 'a -> 'a -> bool
    neq a b = not (eq a b)


impl Eq int where
    eq = Builtin.equalsInteger


impl Eq bytes where
    eq = Builtin.equalsByteString


impl Eq string where
    eq = Builtin.equalsString


impl Eq bool where
    eq a b = not (xor a b)


impl Eq unit where
    eq _ _ = True


impl Eq (list ('a : Big)) where
    eq xs ys =
        eq (Builtin.listData xs) (Builtin.listData ys)


impl Eq 'a => Eq (list ('a : Little)) where
    eq xs ys =
        case xs of
            [] ->
                case ys of
                    [] ->
                        True

                    _ :: _ ->
                        False

            x :: restX ->
                case ys of
                    [] ->
                        False

                    y :: restY ->
                        eq x y && eq restX restY


impl ( Eq 'a, Eq 'b ) => Eq (pair 'a 'b) where
    eq a b =
        let
            pair(firstA, secondA) = a

            pair(firstB, secondB) = b
        in
            eq firstA firstB && eq secondA secondB


impl Eq (map ('k : Big) ('v : Big)) where
    eq xs ys = eq (Builtin.mapData xs) (Builtin.mapData ys)


impl ( Eq 'k, Eq 'v ) => Eq (map ('k : Little) 'v) where
    eq = eqMapEntries


impl Eq 'v => Eq (map ('k : Big) ('v : Little)) where
    eq = eqMapEntries


eqMapEntries : ( Eq 'k, Eq 'v ) => list (pair 'k 'v) -> list (pair 'k 'v) -> bool
eqMapEntries = eq


impl Eq value where
    eq a b = Builtin.equalsData (Builtin.valueData a) (Builtin.valueData b)
sources.Lift:
module Lift exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)

trait Lift 'a 'b where
    lift : 'a -> 'b
    lower : 'b -> 'a

impl Lift int Int where
    lift value = Builtin.iData value
    lower value = Builtin.unIData value

impl Lift bytes Bytes where
    lift value = Builtin.bData value
    lower value = Builtin.unBData value

module Literal exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)

trait FromInt 'a where
    fromInt : int -> 'a

trait FromString 'a where
    fromString : string -> 'a

trait FromBytes 'a where
    fromBytes : bytes -> 'a

impl FromInt int where
    fromInt x = x

impl FromString string where
    fromString x = x

impl FromBytes bytes where
    fromBytes x = x

trait FromBool 'a where
    fromBool : bool -> 'a

trait FromUnit 'a where
    fromUnit : unit -> 'a

impl FromBool bool where
    fromBool value = value

impl FromUnit unit where
    fromUnit value = value
sources.Logic:
module Logic exposing ( not, and, or, xor, (&&), (||) )


import Primitive
import Lift exposing ( Lift )


infix right 2 (||) = or


infix right 3 (&&) = and


{-| Negate a Big or little Boolean, returning bool. -}
not : Lift bool 'a => 'a -> bool
not value =
    if lower value then
        Primitive.False
    else
        Primitive.True


{-| Boolean conjunction. Fully applied calls short-circuit; partial and indirect calls are strict. -}
and : ( Lift bool 'a, Lift bool 'b ) => 'a -> 'b -> bool
and a b =
    if lower a then
        lower b
    else
        Primitive.False


{-| Boolean disjunction. Fully applied calls short-circuit; partial and indirect calls are strict. -}
or : ( Lift bool 'a, Lift bool 'b ) => 'a -> 'b -> bool
or a b =
    if lower a then
        Primitive.True
    else
        lower b


{-| Return True when the Boolean operands differ. -}
xor : ( Lift bool 'a, Lift bool 'b ) => 'a -> 'b -> bool
xor a b =
    if lower a then
        not b
    else
        lower b

validator module VestingParam exposing (main)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)
import Eq exposing (Eq)
import Lift exposing (lower)
import Cardano.Tx exposing (validAfter, signedBy)

type Datum = Datum { owner : Bytes, deadline : Int }

type Redeemer = Claim | Cancel

-- The ledger supplies one V3 ScriptContext; spending datum is in ScriptInfo.
main : int -> Data -> unit
main minimumLock ctx =
    case ctx of
        Constr pair(0, [ tx, action, Constr pair(1, [ _, Constr pair(0, [ datum ]) ]) ]) ->
            check minimumLock (Primitive.coerce datum) (Primitive.coerce action) tx
        _ -> fail

check : int -> Datum -> Redeemer -> Data -> unit
check minimumLock datum redeemer tx =
    case redeemer of
        Claim ->
            assert
                (Builtin.lessThanInteger
                    (Builtin.addInteger (lower datum.deadline) minimumLock)
                    (validAfter tx))
        Cancel -> assert (signedBy tx datum.owner)

module Workloads exposing (..)

import Primitive exposing (..)
import Builtin exposing (..)
import Literal exposing (..)
import Logic exposing (..)

sum : list int -> int
sum xs =
    case xs of
        [] -> 0
        x :: rest -> Builtin.addInteger x (sum rest)

listTraversal : int
listTraversal = sum [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]

countdown : int -> int -> int
countdown n result =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        result
    else
        countdown (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1) result

staticRecursion : int
staticRecursion = countdown 8 42

matchData : Data -> int
matchData value =
    case value of
        I n -> n
        _ -> 0

dataMatch : int
dataMatch = matchData (I 42)

dataMiss : int
dataMiss = matchData (B #"ab")

decode : Data -> int
decode value =
    case value of
        Constr pair(_, [I n, _]) -> n
        _ -> 0

decoding : int
decoding = decode (Builtin.constrData 0 [I 42, I 7])

validate : Data -> unit
validate value =
    case value of
        I n -> assert (Builtin.lessThanInteger 0 n)
        _ -> fail

validationPass : unit
validationPass = validate (I 42)

validationFail : unit
validationFail = validate (I 0)

booleanHelpers : bool
booleanHelpers = (True && False) || (True && True)

constantPrefixTwice : int
constantPrefixTwice =
    Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 1) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 2)

constantPrefixCold : int
constantPrefixCold =
    if True then
        42
    else
        Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 1) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 2)

prefixLoop : int -> int
prefixLoop n =
    if Builtin.equalsInteger n 0 then
        0
    else
        Builtin.addInteger
            (Builtin.addInteger (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 n) (Builtin.subtractInteger 100 n))
            (prefixLoop (Builtin.subtractInteger n 1))

constantPrefixLoop : int
constantPrefixLoop = prefixLoop 8
